lang: Hebrew (English summary p. 170 included in the PDF)
location_note: Kibbutz Ma'ale Ha-Hamisha, found in 1949 while digging a water reservoir; map ref. NIG 2100-10/6360-70, OIG 1600-10/1360-70.
notes: Several tombs hewn in soft hawwar exposed in 1949 during reservoir digging; most destroyed. One preserved elongated cist grave with 3-4 individuals, MB II pottery and metal objects. The modern reservoir is not coded.

features.subtype: several rock-hewn tombs (mostly destroyed); one preserved elongated cist grave (c. 2.45 x 1.2 m deep)
features.quote: One of the tombs, an elongated cist grave
